publications.name: Deep Algorithm Unrolling for Seismic Migration
publications.publisher: 2025 IEEE Conference on Computational Imaging Using Synthetic Apertures
publications.summary: We propose the inverse Radon transform Network (iRADNet), a deep learning-based framework that unrolls the Iterative Shrinkage Thresholding Algorithm (ISTA) into a trainable RNN for solving the inverse Radon transform.

projects.name: Quantum Computing
projects.summary: Quantum computing is the use of quantum-mechanical phenomena such as superposition and entanglement to perform computation. Computers that perform quantum computations are known as quantum computers.
